column_frequency_association.applicability: gate applies when a reference table has a supported grid (frequency labels in header columns) or labelled layout (frequency labels in header columns or per-indication cells) and at least one reaction/column/frequency association; otherwise per-document applicability is reported as false.

comparison_schema.candidate: Rust JSON pages[*].tables[*].{bbox_pt,rows[*].cells[*],lines}; cell text/bold/bboxes and flattened lines are read directly from Rust output.
comparison_schema.reference_table_detection: PyMuPDF page.find_tables() on pages owned by first-copy SmPC 4.8.
comparison_schema.reference_cells: PyMuPDF Table.extract() and its row/cell order; page-span bold flags use the existing production _cell_bold_flags helper.
comparison_schema.reference_flattening: The existing Python production flatten_table_rows() is applied to reference PyMuPDF cells only. It is never called with native candidate cells.
comparison_schema.native_flattening: Native candidate flattened lines are exactly Rust table.lines; Python does not rebuild them from Rust cells.
comparison_schema.table_identity: One-to-one greedy matching of candidate/reference bbox IoU on the same page; reference geometry is comparison-only and does not construct candidate rows.
comparison_schema.row_identity: NFKC+casefold, whitespace-collapsed exact line multiset; reported as a diagnostic.
comparison_schema.frequency_identity: Existing production is_readable_frequency_row and frequency_association_key, which preserve reaction/frequency association while ignoring punctuation and reaction character order.
comparison_schema.column_frequency_identity: Reaction text, indication/frequency column index, and frequency label are compared as a multiset on matched tables; reference-supported unmapped tables count as missed, and unsupported reference layouts are explicitly not applicable.

selection.python_reference: The existing Python production extract_lines/split_sections/first_copy_headings/_table_owner_pages implementation selects first-copy SmPC 4.8 owner pages. This is explicitly the reference selection, not a Rust page-selection result.
selection.native_candidates: Only native tables on those Python-selected 4.8 pages are scored; native tables outside them are counted separately.

explicit_limits: The Python production parser selects section 4.8 pages and its first copy; this experiment does not measure native section-heading or repeated-copy selection.
PyMuPDF TableFinder and production row flattening are the comparison oracle, not an independently adjudicated medical ground truth.

Cell character multiset metrics ignore character order and punctuation. Exact normalized row recall, table bbox matches, reviewed source cases, and Xarelto SOC checks are diagnostics; reaction+column+frequency precision and recall are gated when the reference layout supports that mapping.
Bbox IoU measures table detection agreement, not semantic equivalence; different but useful table boundaries can reduce detection scores.
The reviewed bilingual oracles cover selected Eliquis Table 3 rows, not every adverse reaction, indication column, or table layout in the selected PDFs.
